description: If \(f:A\to N\) is partial elementary between arbitrary nonempty structures and \(a\in\operatorname{acl}_M(A)\setminus A\), there are \(b\in\operatorname{acl}_N(f[A])\setminus f[A]\) and a partial elementary extension with domain \(A\cup\{a\}\), range \(f[A]\cup\{b\}\), and value \(b\) at \(a\).
